findings: Precise inputs with enums and revision guards
No output schemas on any tool
Prose-only descriptions of rich return payloads

assessment.toolCount: The scanner found the 14 unique tools registered at rest across the decision routes. The two adoption tools are intentionally dynamic and bring the complete catalog to 16 only while their corresponding previews are current.
assessment.outputSchemas: WebMCP registerTool has no standard outputSchema member. Cutoff states compact result shapes in every tool description and publishes the generated contract in evals/schema.json rather than adding a non-standard field that the browser would discard.
assessment.coverage: Tools remain scoped to the page where their decision is visible. The fifth scanned page is the read-only build trajectory and intentionally has no decision tools.
